profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Google | Ex-IBM | MS @ CMU
profile.summary: Software engineer with 7+ years of experience, including 5 at Google building secure, large-scale payment systems across backend, Chrome, Android, and web. 2025 Google Tech Impact Award recipient. Led cross-functional projects in AI agentic commerce, risk-based authentication, and card security with partners including Visa, Mastercard, and American Express.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Mountain View, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Agentic Commerce (AI-agent checkout & booking)

Project Lead, agentic checkout form-fill: 
Led 5 engineers to let Google's Buy for me AI agent complete checkout on merchant sites without Google Pay, aligning Shopping, Payments Security, and Travel teams to reach launch readiness.

Payments Autofill (Chrome & Android)

Project Lead, risk-based authentication for Android card autofill (Tech Impact Award): 
Led design through launch across the payments server, orchestration, and Google Play services layers, replacing mandatory CVC/biometric checks with risk verdicts. Cut CVC verifications by ~58% with zero regressions after a FIDO-first redesign cleared security review.

Chrome CVC storage (Tech Impact Award): 
Built CVC save-and-fill for Chrome Autofill in open-source C++ (DB schema, sync, save prompts, metrics), then owned the enhancement design. Launched on all platforms.

Server lead, virtual-card CVC authentication: 
Authored a ~50-page design and launched CVC step-up verification for Chrome virtual cards with American Express, tokenizing codes at the edge so plaintext never reaches internal services; lifted retrieval success by 8% and unblocked the issuer's launch.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Enhanced usability by developing numerous backend APIs, employing the API Facade Design Pattern and Flask to streamline interactions with complex natural language processing algorithm components.
• Significantly improved the IBM Content Analyzer ontology builder's usability through UX enhancements using React, replacing the existing Ontology pages for document class creation, editing, and removal.
• Developed a machine learning-based software, utilizing historical information to optimize the key-value pair extraction process, resulting in a 71.42% processing time reduction and a 5% accuracy improvement, leveraging Python.
• Resolved multiple user interface issues, including pagination errors, dialog box formatting, and responsive design concerns.

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Build supervised machine learning algorithms to predict revenue, cabin class and yield based on Emirates data 
- Visualize data to show future trends for the industry vs EK region by overlaying with the historical data

positions.title: Extreme Blue Senior Technical Intern
positions.description:
• Implemented the "Hooked Methodology" to enhance user engagement through machine learning-based recommendations for IBM Private Cloud, revamping the Front-End and Back-End infrastructure with Segment, Amplitude, React, RESTful APIs, Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB.
• Managed and aggregated audit logs via Kubernetes API, optimizing log filtering processes by modifying YAML configurations. Developed a Python script to fetch and process audit logs, converting Kubernetes API data into actionable commands.

patents.title: Cooperative Neural Network for Recommending Next User Action
patents.description: A method for recommending an action to a user of a user device includes receiving first user action data corresponding to a first user action and receiving second user action data corresponding to a second user action. The method also includes generating, based on the first user action data and the second user action data and using a feedforward artificial neural network, a recommendation for a next user action. The method also includes causing the recommendation for the next user action to be communicated to the user device.
